messages.subject: problem USE  S <- covRob(data  ,estim="M
parts:
Hi

When I use a vulnerable estimator to ROBEST  the correlation matrix, I have the following error, how can this problem be solved

> fit1 <-sem (model= a1, data = data ,se="standard",test = "mean.var.adjusted", estimator ="ML")

> S <- covRob(data  ,estim="M")

Warning message:

'covMest' is deprecated.

Use 'CovMest' instead.

See help("Deprecated")

> sample.mean <- lavInspect(fit1, "sampstat")$mean

> sample.th <- lavInspect(fit1, "sampstat")$th

> attr(sample.th, "th.idx") <- lavInspect(fit1, "th.idx")

> sample.nobs <- lavInspect(fit1, "nobs")

> WLS.V <- lavInspect(fit1, "WLS.V")

> NACOV <- lavInspect(fit1, "gamma")

> fit.bis <- sem(a1, sample.cov = S, sample.mean =sample.mean, sample.th = sample.th, sample.nobs = sample.nobs,

+                WLS.V = WLS.V, NACOV = NACOV,,se="standard",test = "mean.var.adjusted", estimator ="ML",mimic = "EQS")

Error in diag(sample.cov[[g]]) :

  'language' object cannot be coerced to type 'double'
